title: Target language conformance
summary: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing durable target-repository code MUST preserve the target repository's declared language toolchain and MUST verify with its configured commands.
instructions: Agents MUST preserve the target repository's declared language version, formatter, type checker, test runner, module conventions, and dependency boundaries.

Agents MUST NOT relax a compiler, type-checker, or formatter setting to make a change pass, and MUST NOT add a runtime dependency the target repository does not already declare, without an explicit operator directive.
Verification commands MUST remain under REPO-001. Agents MUST use the profiles in runtime/repository-checks.json rather than an assumed ecosystem command.
Workflow-local automation under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ MAY be throwaway and need not conform to this guidance unless it is promoted into durable repository code.
This policy is generated by /pan-build-docs. Agents MUST NOT hand-edit it; they MUST regenerate the bundle when detected languages or target conventions change.
